messages:
sylvia: Heads-up for tomorrow's 01:00-03:00 UTC change window. Small coordinated update touching router graceful drain and runtime pin. Target sequence: router (graceful drain) -> api -> runtime -> console. Versions: router@3.12.1 api@1.17.0 runtime@2.8.1 console@4.5.0. Mike, can you confirm drain timing and any upstream sticky sessions?

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks at 00:40 UTC: migrations OK, no active alerts blocking. Will run pins with 6s spacing. Emitting step events.

mike_ops: Router plan: start graceful drain at T-4m, 45s drain window, check upstream 502/504, then allow pin. There is one legacy client (ID=legacy-sync) with 30s keepalive - I'll coordinate a quick header change to shorten keepalive to avoid long drains.

ana: Runtime warmup: prime /ops/warmup on primary shardset and run 5% canary for 6m. Priming KV prefixes session/* and user_ctx/*. Plan to start warmup at T-8m. Will monitor eviction and memory headroom.

oncall_ben: Rollback thresholds: sustained error rate >0.4% for 5m OR p95 latency +450ms over baseline. Staged rollback plan: undo runtime then api then router; but if router drain caused 502s revert router first. I have unpin perms.

sylvia: Note: console migration uses a feature-flag (FF-console-2048) that we can flip if UI issues appear. Also including release notes with precise ordering and runbook link.

deploybot: Starting sequence: router drain initiated -> router pinned -> api pending -> runtime queued -> console queued. Step IDs: step_1768_a.

mike_ops: Drain started T-4m: connections decreasing, health checks still passing. Legacy client header updated to shorten keepalive.

ana: Warmup started T-8m: /ops/warmup returned 200 across 6 shards. K/V priming showing steady success. Canary shift at T-2m to 5% traffic.

oncall_ben: Quick unpin snippets if needed (I'll run with confirmation):

```
# unpin runtime
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"runtime","version":"2.8.1"}'
# unpin api
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"api","version":"1.17.0"}'
# unpin router (if drain causes issues)
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.12.1"}'
```

sylvia: During the drain be ready to abort pin if 502s spike >0.2% for 2m. If that happens we will: 1) cancel router pin 2) open incident 3) run staged unpin as needed.

deploybot: router pinned -> api pending. Event step_1768_b.

mike_ops: Drain completed, router pinned. No 502 surge observed. Moving to api pin in ~30s.

ana: Canary +3m: runtime canary error rate 0.01%, p95 +9ms. KV priming stable.

oncall_ben: I'll be on pager for the next 45m. If I execute an unpin I'll: mute the deploy-noise alerts, create incident, and post the timeline here.

sylvia: Thanks team. I'll update the release notes with the rollback commands and flag the FF id for console. Will post final completion when console pin passes smoke tests. :white_check_mark:
